title: Reproduction comparison record
description: On-disk machine-readable comparison written by reproduction-executor to <attempt_dir>/comparisons/comparison.json (agent definition v1.1, workflow step 4). One record per locked target id from the approved plan — no more, no fewer (pipeline invariant 3); scripts/reproduction-lane.py check-attempt enforces the one-to-one match and recomputes coverage from the outcomes. Outcome categories are the verdicts-and-precision v1.0 discrepancy classification plus PAPER_ERROR (its paper-error handling rule). Coverage numerator per coverage-rules v1.0: targets reproduced exactly or within pre-stated tolerance = EXACT_MATCH, WITHIN_PRECISION, WITHIN_CONFIDENCE. v1.1 (2026-10-05, gate 1.3 §5) adds per-target output citations: for an attempt run through run-container, each target cites the sealed run outputs it was read from, and a reproduced target that cites none is not admitted until ruled.

plan_sha256.description: sha256 of the approved reproduction-plan.json this comparison scores against

testable.description: False when the target could not be tested (missing data, unbuildable environment); untestable targets stay in the denominator

failure_mode.description: Required in substance when testable is false or the outcome is CANNOT_COMPARE

evidence.description: Path (relative to the attempt directory) of the value-level detail file, or the comparison procedure for visual targets

outputs.description: v1.1: the sealed run outputs this target's values were read from. run is a credited run (the final run or one it consumed); path is relative to outputs/<run>/ as that run's outputs.json lists it (files/<work-copy path>, or stdout.log for printed results); sha256 must equal the sealed digest; lines optionally narrows a text output to a line range

escalations.description: PAPER_ERROR and CANNOT_COMPARE calls surface for human confirmation before entering study data (modernisation plan §4.4)
